offering_description.value: Distributes metalworking tools and maintenance, repair and operations supplies to manufacturers, other industrial businesses, and government agencies. It sources products from manufacturers and ships them through its distribution network. It also manages inventory at customer sites and provides tool reconditioning.

primary_products.value: metalworking cutting tools; abrasives; safety supplies; fasteners; hand and power tools

primary_services.value: inventory management; industrial vending; metalworking process optimization; cutting-tool reconditioning

customer_segment.value: B2B: machine shops, manufacturers, and industrial maintenance departments; B2G: government procurement and maintenance departments

end_markets.value: metal fabrication and machining; aerospace manufacturing; automotive manufacturing; industrial equipment manufacturing; government facilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: metalworking tools and maintenance supplies purchased by industrial and government customers; service fees: cutting-tool regrinding and reconditioning

value_chain_position.value: distributor: sources industrial supplies from manufacturers and sells them to industrial businesses and public agencies; service provider: manages customers’ shop supplies and reconditions used cutting tools for manufacturers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada, and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: metalworking tools, maintenance and safety supplies, inventory management, and tool reconditioning

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field sales representatives, national account teams, and phone ordering; online: e-commerce website and electronic procurement integrations; other: stocked industrial vending machines and managed inventory at customer sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: OSHA hazard communication and transportation rules for storing, handling, and shipping hazardous industrial supplies

notes: The current status of its historical UK operations is uncertain.
